name: 5paisa Capital Ltd
title: 5paisa Capital Ltd - 540776 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Discount broker reports soft Q2 with net profit INR 7.1 crore, lower than Q1, as it keeps spending on technology and brands; no numeric revenue-growth acceleration given, and the prior "growth to accelerate" claim is not repeated.

summary.headline: 5paisa Q2 FY27 revenue INR 86.5 crore (+13% H1 growth to INR 175 crore); net profit fell to INR 7.1 crore as tech spend continued amid weak markets.
summary.overview: Management described Q2 FY27 as a soft quarter for Indian equity markets, with derivatives volumes and average daily turnover (INR 2.59 trillion) down after the cash-segment rollout. Revenue was INR 865 million (INR 86.5 crore) and first-half revenue grew 13% to about INR 1,750 million. Net profit was INR 7.1 crore, lower than Q1, as the company chose to keep investing in technology, product and brand. The rights issue lifted net worth to INR 11,360 million from INR 650 crore at end-March 2026, and the company launched a rebuilt trading and investing app, AlgoSpace and AI assistant "Ask 5paisa".

segments.name: Broking (allied)
segments.commentary: Allied broking income grew 25% YoY in the period. Derivatives volumes fell after the cash-segment rollout, per management.

segments.name: Other operating income
segments.commentary: Other operating income grew 18% YoY. No further breakdown given.

segments.name: Client funding / lending
segments.commentary: Average funding book around INR 480 crore, spread across a large client base rather than a few clients; management said growth is being pursued carefully.

segments.name: Mutual funds (distribution)
segments.commentary: Mutual fund assets on platform at INR 2,095 crore; AI assistant now gives fund recommendations and comparisons (category, expense ratio, fund management).

guidance_outlook: No numerical guidance given on revenue, margins or profit.
Management says it will keep investing in technology, products and brands through the year ahead, and sees the current market softness as a phase in the cycle.

Trendlyne acquisition: Board approved end-July 2026; formal closing still pending. Post-closing, management will decide whether to merge it fully or keep it as a wholly owned subsidiary, and plans to bring Trendlyne's baskets, screeners and AI stack to the 5paisa app regardless of structure.
Company plans to launch an IPO-related product in the near future (no details).
capex_capacity: New trading and investing app rebuilt with new back-end APIs, OMS and RMS; about INR 62 million of costs capitalised this quarter, to be amortised over several years.
Collateral from shares, mutual funds and ETFs now managed in one place; instant withdrawals up to INR 2 lakh per customer account.
Product stack includes AlgoSpace (readymade algo strategies across cash, futures and options), Xstreme APIs, co-location and F&O 360 platform for active traders.
demand_pricing: Customer base 53.4 lakh; about 81,600 new customers added in the quarter; more than 24 million app users; over 95% of new customers onboarded fully self-service (DIY).
Active NSE clients about 46 million; average daily turnover INR 2.59 trillion, reflecting slower trading across the board.
India added roughly 16 million demat accounts in H1 FY27, which management cites as a long-term positive.
Early AI tool traction: products live only weeks to a few months; no retention or conversion data disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: How will the Trendlyne acquisition be positioned, and will it be integrated into the 5paisa app or run separately?
qa_highlights.answer: Board approved the deal end-July, but formal closing is pending; structure (merge or subsidiary) to be decided after closing. Product plan is to bring Trendlyne's baskets, screeners and AI features into the 5paisa app either way.

qa_highlights.question: What engagement or trade conversion is being seen from AI tools, and are users showing higher retention?
qa_highlights.answer: Too early to say; most products have been live only for weeks to a few months. Management expects engagement to rise for mature, useful products, citing Ask 5paisa mutual fund recommendations and comparisons as an example, but has no retention data yet.

risks_watch: Weak trading activity: derivatives volumes and daily turnover fell after the cash-segment rollout; profit fell versus Q1 FY27.
Profitability under continued heavy spend on technology, product and brand, with the new app's capitalised cost (INR 62 million this quarter) to be amortised over several years.
Client funding book expansion (about INR 480 crore average) now that net worth has risen to INR 11,360 million; management says growth will be careful.
Trendlyne acquisition not yet closed; post-closing legal structure and integration plan still open.
Early-stage AI product adoption; no engagement, conversion or retention metrics disclosed yet.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the long-term opportunity and product rebuild, but candid that the quarter was weak and profit fell. Management was vague on the Trendlyne structure and AI engagement, saying both were too early to call.
key_quotes: We see it as a phase in the cycle, and we're using this time to build a stronger business.
Net Profit was INR 7.1 crore, lower than Q1, because we choose to keep investing in technology, product, and brands even though trading activity was slower across the board.
The rights issue has significantly strengthened our Balance Sheet.
